placement_rationale: Homepage intent is broad. Place form immediately after hero and value-prop section to capture high-intent visitors. A secondary slot at page-end catches scroll-through visitors.
Service pages explain what Buildogram does first. Form after the process/scope section captures users who have read and understood the service. Secondary slot at page-end for scroll-through visitors.
competing_form_action: If existing partial form present: inject contextual question as third field. Do not duplicate form.

placement_rationale: Service hub pages are long-form SEO landing pages. Form after process section is the highest-intent placement. Secondary slot after scope list for users who skip ahead.
competing_form_action: Same rule: contextualise existing form rather than adding a competing one. Hub pages often have a contact CTA block.

placement_rationale: Material pages describe product specs and use cases first. Form after the spec/scope section when user understands the material. CTA must use material sourcing language.
RULE: Never before the main article content. Form must appear after the full guide body. Secondary slot at page-end. This is non-negotiable for awareness pages.
RULE: Never interrupt the term definition. Form appears after the definition and related terms. Glossary pages are short; page-end secondary slot is immediately below.
RULE: FAQ answers must appear in full before any form. Form placed after Q&A block; before related guides section. Secondary slot at page-end.
Comparison pages must show the full table and verdict before a form. Form placed after verdict/recommendation section. Secondary at page-end.
Location area pages have an area intro hero. Form immediately after hero+intro captures users who know they need services in that area. Secondary at page-end.
Highest-intent page family. Form after the service scope section for this specific area. These pages are often short; page-end and after-scope may be close together.
competing_form_action: Contextualise existing form if present. Do not add competing form.

placement_rationale: RULE: Form must never appear before the calculator result. Only shown after result is displayed. This is non-negotiable. Secondary at page-end for users who scroll past result.
competing_form_action: If existing result CTA links to a form: contextualise it with the calculator use question. Do not add parallel form.

placement_rationale: Listing pages are browse-mode. Form at page-end avoids interrupting the listing. Sidebar slot for desktop only as a persistent but non-intrusive option.
Profile pages have a professional overview/scope section. Form after that section clarifies Buildogram's role (not the partner's contact). Critical to brand as Buildogram enquiry.
Proof pages tell a story. Form after the outcome/result section of the story. Do not place form mid-narrative. Secondary at page-end.
Case study pages are longer narratives. Form after the outcome/savings section. Do not interrupt the case study body. Secondary at page-end.
About page is trust-building. Form at page-end respects the trust narrative. If page has a process/how-it-works section: secondary slot after that process block.
Process explanation pages convert well after the final step. Form after the last step in the process flow. Secondary at page-end.

Contact page already has a strong primary form that IS the page purpose. Do NOT add any competing inline form. Only action: inject contextual third question into existing form. Widget remains for WhatsApp alternative.
competing_form_action: Contextualise existing form only. No second form added. Widget provides WhatsApp alternative.
